mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.sort_order, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = (u.dept_id - 7000) AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort_order
SELECT id, role_name, role_key, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_role WHERE role_key = #{roleKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
